title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on a cold wooden floor. Dusty shelves tower around you, and the only exit is a heavy iron door with a four-digit keypad. Find a way out.
win_message: The keypad beeps, the lock clicks and the heavy door swings open. Fresh air rushes in. You have escaped the library!

desk.name: oak desk
desk.description: A heavy oak desk with a small locked drawer. A folded note lies on top.
desk.on_examine: The note reads: 'Light reveals what darkness hides.'

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.description: A tall bookshelf full of old leather books. Four red books stand out from the rest.
bookshelf.on_examine: Inside the four red books, from left to right, are handwritten numbers: 4, 8, 1, 5.

clock.name: grandfather clock
clock.description: An old grandfather clock, stopped and silent.
clock.on_examine: An engraving on the clock reads: 'Order matters. Read from left to right.'

drawer.name: desk drawer
drawer.description: A small drawer in the desk, secured with a four-digit combination lock.

painting.name: painting
painting.description: A dark oil painting of a stormy sea. Nothing unusual at first glance.
painting.on_use_uv_torch: Under the violet light, glowing digits appear across the waves: 3 0 7 1.

door.name: exit door
door.description: A heavy iron door with a four-digit keypad.

uv_torch.name: UV torch
uv_torch.description: A small torch that glows violet when switched on.
